text: Close, recognizable small rugged 4x4 rescue jeep driving slowly on a gravel jungle track. Hear a chunky low petrol engine motor running steadily with subtle mechanical rattle, tires crunching dirt and stones, then a gentle brake and engine ignition switched off. One coherent vehicle movement for about four seconds. Realistic jeep, not a generic passing car, no honk, voices, music, crash or cartoon boing.
